title: fin arms registry
description: The arms that share one news stream. An arm is a table, a queue, a budget, a kill switch and an env block; every resource name derives from `prefix` and the arm's `key` (see v2/src/arms.ts armResources and infra/lib/names.ts). The shipped arms.json is the reference experiment.

key.description: Short unique id used in resource names, V2_ARM, transcript prefixes and snapshot keys.

kind.description: agent = the TypeScript Agent SDK investigator (v2/); pipeline = the Rust risk-gated Lambda chain (v1), which also produces the news. A pipeline arm's table is <prefix>-trading and its kill switch /<prefix>/kill-switch.

label.description: Human label for the report, dashboard and letter.

model.description: Bedrock model id (inference profile) the arm decides with. For an agent arm this is the investigator's master model (V2_MASTER_MODEL overrides).

effort.description: Agent arms: reasoning effort passed to the Agent SDK. null = the SDK default (high). V2_EFFORT overrides.

worldModel.description: Agent arms: run with the typed, gated shared world model and the curiosity loop (v3). V2_WORLD_MODEL overrides.

dailyBudgetUsd.description: Initial value of the arm's SSM daily LLM budget (/<prefix>/<key>/daily-budget-usd). The stack seeds the parameter; the worker reads the parameter, not this file. null for a pipeline arm (no metered budget).

maxInvestigationsPerDay.description: Agent arms: the per-day investigation cap. V2_MAX_INVESTIGATIONS_PER_DAY overrides.
